title: NexGo Rating Standard (v0.2.0 draft)
description: Successor draft to nexgo-rating.v0.1.0. Replaces the per-passenger raw blob (which allowed rating anyone and required a global raw scan to read) with ONE typed rating asset per completed ride, GATED on a nexgo-ride-agreement self-addr (verified-ride gating) and queryable per driver. See docs/nexgo-cluster-design-note.md.

self-addr.description: Queryable copy of this asset's register address.

agreement.description: self-addr of the completed nexgo-ride-agreement this rating is for. The verified-ride gate: a rating is only valid if it references a real, completed agreement whose passenger == rater and driver == ratee.

rater.description: Rating party NAMESPACE (the passenger of the agreement).

ratee.description: Rated party NAMESPACE (the driver of the agreement).

avoid.description: If 1, the rater flags this driver as 'to be avoided'.

naming.description: One rating per completed ride agreement.

aggregation.description: Per-driver stats are computed by querying ratings WHERE ratee = '{driver}' AND status = 'active', after verifying each references a valid completed agreement.

computedFields.average: Mean overall score for a driver

examples._comment: A verified rating tied to a completed ride agreement.

nexus.queryFilter: distordia-type = 'nexgo-rating' AND ratee = '{driver namespace}' AND status = 'active'

notes: Verified-ride gating: a rating must reference a completed nexgo-ride-agreement -- you can no longer rate a driver you never rode with (the core v0.1.0 weakness).
Typed JSON + per-ratee query replaces the v0.1.0 global raw scan, which did not scale.
One rating asset per ride (on the passenger's sigchain), not one growing blob per passenger.
Successor draft to nexgo-rating.v0.1.0 (standards/nexgo-rating-standard.json), retained for history.
